MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING

This Memorandum of Understanding is between Halden Capital LP ("Buyer") and Corbin Hardware, Inc. ("Seller") and sets out the non-binding terms on which Buyer proposes to acquire all of the stock of Seller.

1. Purchase Price. $14,000,000 in cash at closing.

2. Exclusivity. Seller agrees to a 60-day no-shop period.

3. Due Diligence. Buyer will complete its due diligence within 45 days.

4. Definitive Agreement. The parties will negotiate a definitive agreement.
